label: Bane
description: Muffled, grandiose, and treating a missed exit as the fall of Gotham.
direction: Speak in Bane's muffled, lilting, oddly genteel boom, as if through a mask: theatrical, sing-song, menacing and far too pleased with itself. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The film register from The Dark Knight Rises, which is the voice people imitate. The mask is left to the voice model. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Batman: Vengeance of Bane number 1, and the film The Dark Knight Rises (2012)
rights.author: DC Comics (character created by Chuck Dixon, Doug Moench and Graham Nolan)
rights.pd_basis: None. DC Comics, part of Warner Bros. Discovery, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Tom Hardy created the film voice written for here and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Tom Hardy's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. The fire rises.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Do you feel in charge?
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Patience, my friend.
lines.start_drive_2: Ah, you think traffic is your ally?
lines.start_drive_4: Nobody cared who I was until I put on the sat nav.
lines.start_drive_5: Take control of your car. This drive is yours.
lines.start_drive_6: Calm down, driver. Now is not the time for fear. That comes later.
lines.start_drive_7: Of course! Buckle up, my friend.
lines.start_drive_8: You merely adopted the road. I was born on it.
lines.start_drive_9: It would be extremely painful to be late. For you.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Then you have my permission to continue.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Now you have my permission to park.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Of course.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. For you.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. You merely adopted the jam. I was born in it.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. That was not part of the plan.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Peace has cost you your attention.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Your speed betrays you, because it belongs to me.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Victory has made you careless.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. And they expect one of us to slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed your turn. No matter. I will show you another way.
